title: Techniques of Computer Science Teaching
description: An initial 1-2 day workshop on teaching techniques followed by a weekly seminar. Course emphasizes teaching skills, practical experience, and communication skills.

title: Teaching of Computer Science

title: Introduction to Computer Science
description: Introduction to computer program development for students with little to no programming experience. Basic programming concepts, variables and expressions, data and control structures, algorithms, debugging, program design, and documentation.

description: Intermediate topics in Computer Science using the Python programming language. Topics include object oriented programming, runtime analysis, data structures, and software testing methodologies.
prerequisites_raw: CMPSC 8 or CMPSC W8 or ENGR 3 or ENGR W3 or ECE 3 with a grade of C or better.

description: Object oriented programming, operating systems, scripting and assembly languages, graphical user interfaces.

title: Foundations of Computer Science

title: Group Studies

title: Computer Science Colloquium
description: Students receiving credit will present talks in their field on material arranged in consultation with the instructor. Credit assigned by the instructor will reflect the extent and quality of participation.

title: Special Topics in Computer Science
description: Lectures on a coherent body of computer science topics which are not usually presented in standard computer science courses.
